mapper.select: select CD_ID, CD_CLS_ID, CD_NM, CD_DESC, REC_ST, REG_ID, REG_DT, UPD_ID, UPD_DT from JCMS_CD where CD_ID = #{cdId} and DEL_DT IS NULL
select COUNT(CD_ID) from JCMS_CD where DEL_DT IS NULL and CD_CLS_ID = #{cdClsId} and REC_ST = #{recSt}
select COUNT(CD_ID) from JCMS_CD where DEL_DT IS NULL and (CD_ID = #{cdId} OR CD_NM = #{cdNm})
mapper.insert: insert into JCMS_CD ( CD_ID, CD_CLS_ID, CD_NM, CD_DESC, REC_ST, REG_ID, REG_DT ) values ( #{cdId}, #{cdClsId}, #{cdNm}, #{cdDesc,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{recSt}, #{regId}, SYSDATE() )
mapper.update: update JCMS_CD set CD_NM = #{cdNm}, CD_DESC = #{cdDesc,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, REC_ST = #{recSt}, UPD_ID = #{updId}, UPD_DT = SYSDATE() where CD_ID = #{cdId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and DEL_DT IS NULL
mapper.delete: delete from JCMS_CD where CD_ID = #{cdId} and CD_CLS_ID = #{cdClsId}
